message: Each label is a cell-year whose climate input is accumulated to its observation day; ALT is predicted as a recalibrated Stefan anchor plus a down-weighted gradient-boosting residual, evaluated under five validation designs, label-number and new-region experiments, and applied to year-labelled maps and same-cell, same-year product comparison.
medium: Scientific Reports main-text figure, 180 mm wide, about 150-165 mm tall, fixed canvas (no tight bbox)
style_source: docs/PAPER_PLAN_v11_2026-10-16.md section 4; design/style_tokens_v4.json color.paper_v11 via polar.style_v5 (POLAR_PALETTE=paper11)

layout.grid: 180 x 160 mm; three full-width rows; panel letter in a 4.5 mm gutter with the row header and a hairline on the same line; one element-label line per row (7.4 mm below the row top); content edges 4.8-179.2 mm
layout.a: Cell-year design: two-column soil schematic (observation day, end of season) | cumulative TDD of one Lena Delta cell in 2013 (TDD_obs, full season, 2011-2024 mean, other years) | four-row cell-year table (two cells x 2013, 2021)
layout.b: Physics-residual model: Stefan anchor scatter (Alaska labels, E = 1.95) | equation strip over a two-lane Alaska 2014 map flow: inputs (climate/terrain/soil) -> gradient boosting g(x) -> residual map; full-season TDD -> Stefan -> Stefan map; plus node (lambda) -> ALT 2014; dashed training target
layout.c: Evaluation and outputs: five validation designs on Lena Delta label cells | schematic label-number and new-region curves at the design steps || compared structures with Figs 3-4 line keys | ALT anomaly 2012, 2019 | same-cell, same-year dot plot (Lena Delta cell-year 2013: observed, this study, four products)

encoding.accent: #D1603D (proposed method): gradient boosting block tint, residual path, ALT 2014 frame, residual segments
encoding.physics: #2E6DA4 (Stefan recalibrated): Stefan line, Stefan block tint, Stefan map frame
encoding.text: #262626, FreeSans 6-7 pt, letters 8 pt bold, equation 8 pt
encoding.boxes: operation blocks only, light tint fill, #808080 0.5 pt edge
encoding.connectors: 0.6-0.7 pt, horizontal/vertical only, small open chevrons
encoding.maps: ALT oslo_r, residual and anomaly vik (symmetric), inputs lajolla (climate) grayC (terrain) bamako (soil)

data: data/processed/v5/runs/core_v6/preds (fold check for the validation-design maps)
qa: automatic (font size >= 6 pt, FreeSans only, no text overlap, no text outside canvas, no text over map frames or touching connectors) plus visual review of the 600 dpi PNG; result recorded in source_data JSON
revisions: drawn hat over ALT (mathtext widehat renders an oversized wedge in FreeSans)
orphan product key replaced by a real-data dot plot (coordinator review)
vector exports saved at 600 dpi so embedded rasters meet the 450 ppi rule

reviewer fixes: 'Schematic' tag on the two curve icons, 'Seasonally frozen' key, '19 > 200 cm' axis-end count, accent frame on the residual map, excluded cells as open rings drawn above training dots, 'Full season' label on the TDD -> Stefan connector

qa_result.visual: 600 dpi PNG and 600 dpi PDF raster checked row by row; independent scientific-figure-reviewer pass applied (schematic tag, seasonally frozen key, off-scale count, residual map frame, excluded rings); coordinator review applied (real-data same-cell, same-year dot plot)
